notes.title: Fhtagn! now available on Nintendo Switch and featured on Co-Optimus
notes.notes:
Hi there, Doomsday cultists! The time has come to set our sights on a new world to destroy. Thanks to our partners over at Silesia Games, Fhtagn! is now available on the Nintendo Switch and finally you can play it the way you're supposed to ... on the toilet! 😏

You can check it out on the Switch store [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/fhtagn-tales-of-the-creeping-madness-switch/]here[/url] and get it at a 30% discount for the next 14 days. 

And while you're at it, why not check what Co-Optimus has to say about the game [url=https://www.co-optimus.com/article/16838/board-adventure-game-fhtagn-tales-of-the-creeping-madness-coming-to-switch-in-august.html]here[/url].

notes.title: Remote Destroy Together
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32132260/c045be26ade22c5e848bbbdca5f7eb2900ec74a5.jpg[/img]

Ever wanted to summon an ancient slavering monstrosity to end the world … for reasons … but just couldn’t get your cultist friends to agree to come to your sanctum. Something about them not trusting you to not poison the Oreos … Well, now with Steam Remote Play, those problems are a thing of the past … and hopefully a Thing in the future!

As of version 2.1.3.a you can now play Fhtagn! Tales of the Creeping Madness remotely with your friends, without the threat of them stabbing you in the back when you are not paying attention. You can now play:
[olist]
[*] Co-operatively or competitively online with your friends (or frenemies).
[*] Play on your tablet.
[*] AND, if you have REALLY good eyesight, on your phone (unfortunately the font size cannot be optimised at this time, so a tablet is recommended).
[/olist]

To activate Remote Play, just follow these easy instructions on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay/]Steam’s webpage[/url] .

So what are you waiting for? Go end the world!

notes.title: New update, new project, Fall Sale and other thrilling news!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32132260/affa0ffda09c40e9a187bd97573b6093d5baa83e.jpg[/img]

We have been hard at work on an exciting new project, The Endless Wyrd. In this dice-based, deck-building roguelike adventure, scavenge the Wyrd and escape the tentacles and teeth of The Thing of the Dark. Load your dice with powerful augments to create your own synergies and combos and stack the odds in your favour. In the rabbit hole of the Wyrd, the only way back up, is down. 

Don’t miss out on exciting updates and announcements and follow The Endless Wyrd on [url=https://twitter.com/EndlessWyrd]twitter[/url]. We will be launching an in-game trailer soon! 

Because of our hectic production timelines to launch The Endless Wyrd on early access on Steam, we will be halting monthly story packs for Fhtagn! However, you can still create your own fun stories for you and friends to play in-game (read more about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/802400/announcements/detail/1595884371686585768]here[/url]). Fhtagn!’s [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DUepp28]Discord server[/url] is also a great space to test ideas, get feedback and receive assistance and guidance from us. It’s a fun community full of cultish shenanigans, where you can chat to friendly folks and have a prohibition cocktail at Madame Fufu’s to boot. 

[h1]New feature update in Fhtagn! - V2.1.2.a[/h1]
We will continue to support and maintain Fhtagn! and have recently added a new feature to the game that enables players to delete saved files. This is useful if your Steam files somehow got corrupted or if you want a fresh start to the game. Please note that using this feature will remove all elders signs and unlocks. The feature is located in the Settings menu. 

[previewyoutube=yCgnlvfor8k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Special Promotion: Fall Sale[/h1]
To celebrate the creepiest season of the year, we are having a Fall Sale. Please note that Fhtagn! is currently our means to fund the amazing new projects we’re developing, like The Creeping Madness and The Endless Wyrd. The more copies of Fhtagn! that are purchased, the more resources we have to effectively develop new projects and reduce production timelines. As bootstrapping Indies we could really use your support!

notes.title: Create your own co-op adventures in Fhtagn!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yCgnlvfor8k
Hopefully by this time you have played Fhtagn! and thought [i]"Hey, I can write better stuff than they can!"[/i]. If the thought had not yet crossed your mind, it should - It's so easy to create your own adventures with the Fhtagn! Content Creator. All that is needed is a story idea and no programming is required. The community has already added a few fun mods on the workshop for other players to download and enjoy in-game. 

[h1]It’s so Fhtagn easy! [/h1]
How does it work?
[list]
[*] Start with an idea (about anything you wish and as funny or as serious as you want);
[*] write an intro for the story event;
[*] choose two actions;
[*] choose a stat for each action;
[*] write pass and fail stories for each action;
[*] and viola, you have a playable event in Fhtagn!
[/list]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/3cd1065434a7197c24b6bc3e48526519fba71c7f.png[/img]

We provided players with a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0GNqm98NwJk&feature=youtu.be]Quick start video guide[/url], [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hCfFu0_DLKey5KTDP2qve8TYS3ZOWcda]Content Creator Guide[/url] and even released all of Fhtagn!'s [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hCfFu0_DLKey5KTDP2qve8TYS3ZOWcda]event stories[/url] to aid in this process. If you are interested in creating your own stories, you can check out more information about our Content Creator, on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/802400/discussions/0/1692669912406327550/]forum [/url]or join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DUepp28]Fhtagn! Discord server[/url].


[h1]That Fhtagn Discord Server[/h1]
We want to help community members create their own story packs (cooperative or solo endeavours) for the game and our Discord server is a great space to test ideas, get feedback and receive assistance and guidance from us.

Do you like... 
✅ Interactive stories
✅ Fun community hangouts
✅ Imaginary bootleg liquor 
✅ Cultist shenanigans

Then you will love [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DUepp28]Fhtagn!'s discord server[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/b0355402e85a67c41e8925083872cd882adcf83b.gif[/img]

We also provide our awesome community with a writing prompt on our Discord server (in the Story Time channel) and the community then writes amazing story contributions, which other members can vote on. Winning contributions are combined to create the final story event for players to enjoy ingame. After each completed Story Time event, the community mod will be updated with the new stories. Credits for contribution can be found in the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hCfFu0_DLKey5KTDP2qve8TYS3ZOWcda]Discord Community Mod sheet[/url].


[h1]What the Fhtagn is this all about? [/h1]
Dubbed the [i]"funniest take on mystic doomsday cults in years"[/i], Fhtagn! is a choose-your-own-adventure game where you can play as one of four cultists intent on destroying the world by summoning an Ancient Horror. Decide how you will be preparing for the final ritual by visiting various locations in the unsuspecting town of Arkham and navigating iconic Lovecraftian events. Battle investigators, gangs, corrupt cops and horrors from the Depths to bring about the end of the world!

This text-based adventure game boasts:

• 93 000 words.
• Across 113 events with 370 potential story outcomes.
• Fulfil 1 of 24 roles with 56 role feedback stories.
• 142 different character endings.


[h1]Talk to us[/h1]
There is only one thing we like more than making games and that is to connect with the community. We have various social platforms available for you to enhance your experience of Fhtagn!, from our [url=https://designimps.com]website[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/DesignImps]twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FhtagnGame/]subreddit[/url], [url=https://designimps.com]newsletter [/url]and our newly launched [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DUepp28]Discord server.[/url] 

What the Fhtagn! are you waiting for? Drop us a comment or feel free to connect with us on the social platforms mentioned above.

notes.title: Be the hero we need this #loveindies 2019!
notes.notes:
As indie developers, we cannot make games without your support or feedback. Please take the time the following two weeks of #loveindies celebration (3 - 14 June) to review indie games you’ve enjoyed. Be part of the celebration - your opinion matters and will make a world of difference!

The main way to get involved is to write a few reviews for games on your platform of choice and share them at any time throughout the two weeks. Remember to use #loveindies, tag the developer and link to the game when you do. This will help the game be discovered by new players! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/2bcecba9b123cc8054b903aa5a8584c96abaa230.gif[/img]

[h1]#loveindies Review Hour[/h1]
If you really want to go [b]BIG[/b], you can be part of the #loveindies Review Hour At 1000 PST (1800 BST) on Saturday, 8 June. For one hour, you need to review as many indie games from your library as you can. Just go to your library, open it up, and run through everything you’ve got, giving (short) reviews to all of the indie titles you haven’t reviewed yet.

This is the only activity which is strictly timed, to try and gain some momentum for the event over the weekend. If you can, build it up in advance and then join in when it’s happening!


[h1]Design Imps: Doing our part [/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/199f7f068811289577bdcc0e8d917fe25d2ebb52.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/ce8cfa405d163e5171f46da3ff154ff3562309c0.png[/img][/url] 
We’re not only indie devs, we're also avid gamers and we love playing games just as much as we love making them! Design Imps will also take part in this awesome initiative (created by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/failbettergames/]Failbetter Games[/url]) to support fellow indie devs and their amazing projects. Be sure to check out our [url=https://twitter.com/DesignImps]twitter account[/url] to see some indie love! 


[h1]Thank you for supporting Fhtagn![/h1]
We want to give a special thank you to everyone who has supported Fhtagn! and made this journey worthwhile. Every comment, every review, every video and every interaction with players has meant the world to us.

notes.title: Fhtagn!’s one year anniversary and first community-written story pack!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/b0355402e85a67c41e8925083872cd882adcf83b.gif[/img]

Grab the Wailing Gramophone, bust out the Maltese Cockerel, put on the Pinky Ring of Albrecht the Fabulous, it is time to paaaarty! Today is Fhtagn!’s one year anniversary and in honour of this momentous occasion we have a special promotion to celebrate. The past year has been an incredible journey with many exciting developments. We’ve released the Dark Young expansion that included a new cult, new Ancient One, useable items, more stories, new game mechanics and more investigators. We’ve also made various improvements to the Fhtagn! Content Creator so that it is even easier to upload your own stories for the game. 

We will also continue to upload the usual Fhtagn! story packs each month. 

[h1]Community-written story pack[/h1]
With a year of connecting with players and telling stories together, it is such a privilege to upload the first community-written story pack for players to enjoy. You can check it out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1748572423]here[/url]. 

[h1]How does it work?[/h1] 
We provide our awesome community with a writing prompt on our Discord server (in the Story Time channel) and the community then writes amazing story contributions, which other members can vote on. Winning contributions are combined to create the final story event pack for players to enjoy ingame. After each completed Story Time event, the community mod will be updated with the new stories. Credits for contribution can be found in the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hCfFu0_DLKey5KTDP2qve8TYS3ZOWcda]Discord Community Mod sheet[/url].

Don’t miss out on future awesome story events and subscribe to see more stories written by the community for the community. If you want to be part of the fun, join our Discord server - [url=https://disboard.org/server/553559513865912341]That Fhtagn Server[/url].

Talking about our Discord server, you can also get a delicious piece of chocolate cake from Fred O'Leary in the Madame Fufu's channel. What is a celebration without a Devilishly Delicious Chocolate Cake! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/b26f3c9280ad0101794d8404caca7b141b1875b7.png[/img]

[h1]The Creeping Madness[/h1]
Fhtagn!’s stories and world is based on our flagship title, The Creeping Madness, currently in concept development. Check out the Concept Reel below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UyM8gY4rMEU&t
The Creeping Madness (TCM) is Black and White meets Evil Genius in the 1930s, inside a Lovecraft novel, with a hint of Dieselpunk. You are a Cthulhu-esque Ancient One hellbent on walking the mortal realm once more. Build up your cult in secret. Summon powerful monsters and play through tactical scenarios from your favourite Lovecraftian novels, as you slowly infiltrate, manipulate, corrupt and drive people insane to orchestrate your return.

We created Fhtagn! to raise extra funds for TCM, we are currently hard at work on this project and we hope to share more news about TCM with you soon! 

[h1]Thank you for supporting Fhtagn![/h1]
We want to give a special thank you to everyone who has supported Fhtagn! and made this journey worthwhile. Every comment, every review, every video and every interaction with players has meant the world to us. We truly hope you enjoyed playing Fhtagn! as much as we enjoyed making it.

notes.title: New story event pack, Discord server and other news!
notes.notes:
In this month’s story event pack, you can now use 4 of the items introduced in the Dark Young Expansion, in the base game.

Will you fight to the death for Black Annis' Claws? Or manage to track down the Osslein Phylactery in the underground ruins outside of Constantinople? Will you survive a deal with the Bargainer for the Voice of Lao? Or win a high-stakes poker match with Madame Fufu for her prized pinky ring of Albrecht the Fabulous? Any one of these ancient relics will undeniably imbue the victor with dark and sometimes fabulous powers. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/a27793b61b90f249cca504db60d7e00197400cac.png[/img]   [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/3c895872b8192034a8be942a4f2254142b793f77.png[/img]   [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/c67731c27f72799a5aa97a5a6ca3dce475592ca4.png[/img]   [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/4754b3fe32d7d60a60862c0d5fb114bf5248722f.png[/img]

You can now download the 'Relics of the Thousand Young' event pack on our Steam Workshop [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1729756935]here[/url]. Just click subscribe and refresh your mods list ingame. 

We will be adding monthly event packs at the end of each month, which we’ve started in March. Unfortunately, we had to fix an issues that caused the mods to not appear properly and for that reason April’s event pack is a few days late. We apologise for the delay, but now that everything is up and running properly again, we hope you enjoy the latest addition. 

[h1]Join the cultish shenanigans on our Discord server[/h1]
Our Discord server, That Fhtagn! Server, has been live for a month now and we had a lot of fun so far. We’ve almost completed the first community-written story event pack! As soon as the writing contributions are finalised, we will combine all the winning story contributions and upload it as mod for players to enjoy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/b26f3c9280ad0101794d8404caca7b141b1875b7.png[/img]

You can also hangout at #Madame Fufu’s, the best speakeasy in town where the only thing smoother than the jazz band is the bootleg whisky. Here you can just sit back, relax and order a drink from Fred O'Leary. We have a great prohibition drinks menu (order a Sidecar, Torpedo Juice, Monkey Gland and more) and the higher your rank, the more variety you can order.

We also have a Fhtagn! Adventures channel, where you will play out story events through a community voting system.

If you want to write your own mod for the game and would like help with that, please feel free to join our Discord server. It’s a great space to test ideas, get feedback and receive assistance and guidance from us. 

You can join the server by clicking on the Discord button on Fhtagn’s main menu ingame or you can join the server [url=https://disboard.org/server/553559513865912341]here[/url]. 

[h1]Linux and SteamOS compatible[/h1]
Please note that Fhtagn! Is now Linux and SteamOS compatible.

[h1]The Creeping Madness - Concept Reel (TCM)[/h1]
Fhtagn! is a text-based choose-your-own-adventure game, whose stories and world is based on our flagship title, The Creeping Madness, currently in concept development. Check out the Concept Reel below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UyM8gY4rMEU&t=
The Creeping Madness (TCM) is Black and White meets Evil Genius in the 1930s, inside a Lovecraft novel, with a hint of Dieselpunk. You are a Cthulhu-esque Ancient One hellbent on walking the mortal realm once more. Build up your cult in secret. Summon powerful monsters and play through tactical scenarios from your favourite Lovecraftian novels, as you slowly infiltrate, manipulate, corrupt and drive people insane to orchestrate your return.

We created Fhtagn! to raise extra funds for TCM, we are currently hard at work on this project and we hope to share more news about TCM with you soon! 

[h1]Connect with us[/h1]
We want to remind you of the best way you can enhance and experience Fhtagn! We have various social platforms available from our [url=https://www.designimps.com]website[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/DesignImps]twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FhtagnGame]subreddit[/url], [url=https://www.designimps.com]newsletter [/url]and our newly launched [url=https://disboard.org/server/553559513865912341]Discord server[/url]. 

What the Fhtagn! are you waiting for? Talk to us!

notes.title: Fhtagn! Discord server and other thrilling news
notes.notes:
The year is in full swing and we’d like to share with you what we’ve been busy with and some interesting projects to come.

[h1]Fhtagn! Discord Server[/h1]
Do you like... 
✅ Interactive stories
✅ Fun community hangouts
✅ Imaginary bootleg liquor 
✅ Cultist shenanigans
Then you will love Fhtagn!'s discord server!

There is only one thing we like more than making games and that is to connect with the community. We’ve created a Discord server, called [url=https://disboard.org/server/553559513865912341]That Fhtagn! Server[/url], to connect with players and create a space for community members, who enjoy a fun community hangout, interactive stories and imaginative worlds, to just chill and enjoy the insanity together.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/b26f3c9280ad0101794d8404caca7b141b1875b7.png[/img]

The server has various interesting channels, but below are a few examples.
 
[b]#Fhtagn! Chat[/b] 
Where you can chat and explore the bizarre and maddening world of Fhtagn!

[b]#Story Time[/b]
In Story Time you can write short stories for the game and vote on other community members’ contributions. This can be a great way to practice your writing muscles, hang out with the community, have a platform where you can read a bunch of awesome short stories or just get a kick out of seeing people interact with your story.

[b]#Madame Fufu’s[/b]
Madame Fufu’s, is the best speakeasy in town and the only thing smoother than the jazz band is the bootleg whisky. Here you can just sit back, relax and order a drink from Fred O'Leary. This channel is meant to be a light roleplaying experience. Think prohibition, mafia, flappers, swing and jazz and fun words like “bee’s knees, giggle water, phonus balonus and zozzled”!

Other channels include Interactive Fiction, Writer’s Nook, Mod Room, Official News etc. Don’t be a stranger, come check it out!

[h1]Monthly event packs[/h1]
Every month we will upload a Fhtagn! event pack (downloadable mod) with interesting event stories, beginning with March. You can now download the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1686798194]first event pack[/url], which contains 8 backstories that will feature in cycle one of Fhtagn!’s intro stories. These stories will give your character a randomised backstory, with a unique new flavour. Each backstory is a wildcard that will give you massive starting strengths and weaknesses. Will you be the corrupt politician, the twin sister with a dark family secret or a lovestruck loafer on an African adventure? The backstories will not only entertain and make you laugh, but more than one might creep you the hell out! To access the mod, just go to your Mods button in-game, select More mods and subscribe to the Character backstories mod. Enjoy!

notes.title: Dark Young expansion is now live: Sacrifice your friends and summon a new Ancient Horror!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/62739770c77b859225a7caa00381ead519be8b5a.png[/img]

[h1]Hi there fellow World-enders![/h1]

Finally, you can sacrifice your friends and summon an Ancient Horror in the new Dark Young expansion. The expansion includes a new cult, new Ancient One, now with useable items, more stories, new game mechanics and more investigators.

There is a new cult in town – The Thousand Young (selectable from the Cult Select Page). These sycophantic backstabbers are devoted to the All-Mother and Mother only wants the best and the brightest. You have 6 rounds to build up the required stats needed to use the ritual items in the final ritual, but you also need to outwit your [i]“friends”[/i] and make sure it is them on the chopping block and not you.

The Dark Young expansion is now live and you can find all the fixes, changes and additions below.

[h1]Features and Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]New cult
[*]New set of role cards
[*]Sacrifice, voting and escape systems
[*]Set of escape cards
[*]AI Players
[*]Dark Young
[*]Encounters with the Dark Young
[*]The Ancient One's minions can be a part of the defence phase
[*]Some items have special endings when used in the ritual
[*]Building mouse overs will now have status indicators for the Dark Young
[*]Vote movement summary with vote leader being indicated at the end of each round
[*]Items, buffs and henchmen added to the game
[*]Additional stories and events
[*]Event summary screen now has tooltips on the icons
[*]Changed the way tooltip legends are accessed with the keyboard and gamepad. It is now toggled instead of displayed while the button is held down and the keyboard button changed from Alt to Shift.
[*]Added 21 new achievements
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]When the player has more than 4 mods installed, all will now display in the mod list
[*]Defence achievement for Cthulhu is now achievable
[*]Player order based on player influence did not take the starting player order into account when two players had the same number of influence points
[*]Generic fallback event will no longer cause a game breaking error
[*]Scrolling through the list of available resolutions with the controller now scrolls all the way to the bottom
[*]Building mouse overs now correctly scale. Previously the mouse overs on 4k monitors were extremely small.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
Thank you for supporting Fhtagn! and helping us to improve the game, we appreciate you all!

notes.title: Dark Young expansion launches on 22 October 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/62739770c77b859225a7caa00381ead519be8b5a.png[/img]

With the Halloween season in full swing, celebrate the most frightful of holidays with an expansion that will both chill and tickle your funny bone! On 22 October 2018, we will be launching The Dark Young expansion for Fhtagn! - Tales of the Creeping Madness. 

The expansion includes: 
[list]
[*] New cult
[*] New Ancient One
[*] Now with useable items
[*] More stories
[*] New game mechanics
[*] More investigators
[/list]

In its first instalment, this party/boardgame-esque game saw the cult of The Dreaming Eye trying wake the thing of the idols, that green, sticky spawn of the stars (can you guess who?) to claim the world. Now, there is a new cult in town – The Thousand Young. These sycophantic backstabbers are devoted to the All-Mother and Mother only wants the best and the brightest. 

You have 6 rounds to build up the required stats needed to use the ritual items in the final ritual, but you also need to outwit your “friends” and make sure it is them on the chopping block and not you. For every successful round you complete, you get ‘Not It’ stacks, which you use in the end of the game to determine who will be sacrificed to dear Mother. The player who receives the most votes will become the juicy glazed ham on the altar in the Dark Forest. Or will they? Should you be voted as the sacrifice, you will have the chance to escape and GTFO outta there!

Don’t miss out on this thrilling experience and remember to update your game on 22 October 2018! 

[h1]Check out the expansion trailer![/h1] 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c9PFGOTjh28

notes.title: New ways to talk to us!
notes.notes:
At Design Imps, we have a passion for connecting with the community and to be part of a project where as a community, we can all contribute to making the games we all want to play. To further cement this philosophy, we have created two new avenues for you as the community to interact with us and we want to remind you of the best way to enhance and experience Fhtagn!

[h1]Fhtagn! subreddit[/h1]
The first way for you to communicate with us and help us to create the game that you want to play is through our new [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FhtagnGame/]subreddit[/url]! We hope to share some informative and fun topics on the subreddit and to create another space where we can connect with players. So why not join us and let us know about your favourite stories in the game, which stories you would like to see or share with us a story that you want to write in our Content Creator!
 
Here is already something fun for you to do on your Friday, complete our quirky [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScGBKJZ9QvzWglOzWDli6-ZHAoGfaZbbOrQ3MYmYA3J4gbTyQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]poll[/url] in our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FhtagnGame/comments/95b5a6/in_a_postapocalyptic_world_ruled_by_an_ancient/]'In a post-apocalyptic world ruled by an Ancient Evil, where would you be?'[/url] post!
 
[h1]Game testing[/h1]
We have opened up testing to the community! If you want to take part and help us improve Fhtagn! in a practical way, check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/802400/discussions/0/1759104780482505883/]discussion[/url] of how you can get involved.

[h1]Share your mad genius with the community![/h1]
 When we created the Fhtagn! Content Creator, the idea was to empower players to create their own content and become actively involved in content they were playing in the game. If you wanted stories that are more sinister or about a certain topic, you could either download a mod or write it yourself. The game really shines in co-op with friends, so how about creating a campaign or fun stories for you and your friends to enjoy! There are so many possibilities. 

Write stories for Fhtagn! with these easy steps:
[list]
[*]Start with an idea (about anything you wish and as funny or as serious as you want);
[*]write an intro for the story event;
[*]choose two actions;
[*]choose a stat for each action;
[*]write pass and fail stories for each action;
[*]and viola, you have a playable event in Fhtagn!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/c19d5b5da72680660cd22b2688864910c3b596fa.png[/img]

No programming is required and we are committed to simplifying the app as much as possible to make sure anyone can create their own stories. We’d love to know how we can assist to make this experience as enjoyable and as easy as possible, so let us know what we can do to help either in the discussion pages or in the subreddit.

notes.title: Dark Young Reveal
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32132260/e818adc6d59a7be62eca5523a4e3f61014e75fb5.png[/img]

It’s been almost a month since the launch of our mini-game Fhtagn! - Tales of the Creeping Madness and we are excited to announce our first major content update, lovingly called the “Dark Young update”. Okay, okay, we admit we could have chosen a subtler name and if you know anything about Lovecraft, it will be no surprise to you who the new Ancient One will be, but we just couldn’t resist! So without further ado … Iä! Iä! Let’s get this party started!

[h1]What can you expect:[/h1]
The Dark Young update includes a new cult who worships the All-mother. This cult is far more back-stabbing than the Dreaming Eye, since Mother does not look kindly on failing and her children know that she will not suffer the weak to live.

To help even the most altruistic player embrace their inner backstabber, the game mode includes two new mechanics.
[list]
[*]“Disappointed Mother” will cause the player to spawn Dark Young across the map and let’s just say they didn’t come to congratulate you on a job well done. 
[*]“Survival of the fittest” gives players stacks of “Not it!” whenever they pass an event or complete special objectives. At the end of the game players will use their stacks to determine which of them will be the sacrifice, but beware, Mother will not be happy if there are no snacks for her little babies.
[/list]
These are just a taste of what you can expect! We are looking forward to have the update in your hands as soon as possible!

notes.title: Updates, Features and Fixes - V1.0.9
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone! We're in full swing with the Dark Young update, but have not forgotten about those nasty bugs and nice-to-haves! Thank you all for your patience with the growth process, we really appreciate it! 

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]We really wanted to give credit to our modders for the excellent work they have done, so from now on when you play a mod, you will be able to see the mod and the modder's name at the bottom of the story area.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Can now scroll through the mod list using the controller's right stick.
[*]Controller stick threshold checks were faulty. Thresholds being checked correctly now, and change to controller threshold increased.
[*]Moving down on Mod screen with top button selected jumped to bottom button. Now correctly flows from top, to mid, to bottom.
[*]Content Creator fix: Partial destruction of buildings should now correctly only destroy the correct option, instead of the whole building. 
[/list]
[h1]The way forward[/h1]
As we mentioned before, we are hard at work on the Dark Young update and we will be sharing some of the progress shortly. We also have some special plans for modders, which we will reveal soon. Other than that we will be sticking to our patching schedule, to fix any of those annoying bugs, as they creep out of the Depths. Thank you all for your support! Stay sane!

notes.title: Updates, Features and Fixes - V1.0.8
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for playing Fhtagn! and for the incredible feedback we have received so far. It has been a week since Fhtagn! launched and all kinds of Yrm-Tahl worms had come out of the woodwork. Don’t worry, we have maxed out our Sanity and Animal Husbandry and we have wrangled up those troublesome critters (bugs) and banished them for good! 

This update focuses primarily on the way Fhtagn! deals with user created content, specifically in the way new mods are uploaded and updated on the Steam Workshop. For modders, please look at the updated Content Creator document, for changes. You can see what has changed in the revision history, on the first page. To all the achievement hunters out there, we added 16 new achievements for you. Finally, as we mentioned, we tracked down a few bugs and implemented fixes for them, details below.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Investigator can now become a part of the ritual – Every ritual needs a pesky investigator, don’t you think? 
[*]Added [i]“how mods work”[/i] info and [i]“how to create mod”[/i] infographic to the mods screen. We don’t want you to miss out on all fantastic and insane stories created by the community.  
[*]Steam workshop update - Mods must now have a preview image. Because everything looks better with pictures.
[*]Steam workshop update – Existing/published mods can now be updated. If you wanted to change the love interest in your story from a Shoggoth to a Mi-Go – now you can! 
[*] Added 16 new achievements. Oooooh, shiny!
[/list] 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Elder signs are now correctly awarded for stats at or above 10 on the score screen.
[*]Can no longer open the elder sign unlock confirmation with controller, if you do not have enough elder signs.
[*]Spending riches on event option is now reflected in the event summary.
[*]Button active state no longer removes button side images.
[*]Steam cloud data now being loaded when the game starts to avoid syncing issues when playing on a different PC, or with multiple accounts on the same PC.
[*]Fixed an issue with character anti-climaxes, where anti-climaxes based on stats showed too frequently. This was balanced out so that anti-climaxes based on role and stats have an equal chance of appearing. 
[*]Fixed an issue with follow-up events which didn’t trigger properly and the events will now trigger more consistently. 
[*]Found and fixed a few typos.
[*]The Haunter of the Dark mod has been down-scaled slightly to make the first couple of follow-up events a bit easier (it is still very difficult though, so BEWARE!).
[/list]

[h1]The way forward[/h1]
We are hard at work on the Dark Young update, which will include more investigators, a new Ancient One, with new game mechanics and plenty of backstabbing. We will also continue to improve the game and Content Creator based on the feedback from the community. 
 
Thank you for all the support and we hope you’re enjoying the game. If you haven’t done so yet, check out the new mods on the Steam Workshop, the community has done an excellent job!

notes.title: Announcing the end of the world with the release of Fhtagn! on 22 May 2018!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our story-adventure mini-game, Fhtagn, is releasing on Steam tomorrow, 22 May 2018! The time is finally at hand to perform the great ritual and everything has been meticulously prepared. The sacred spoon of Scoo’p has been polished to an evil gleam, the Shoggoth was given a juicy bone and the altar was sprinkled with ketchup (the Ancient One’s favourite). All we need now is for you to fulfil your ritual role and to end the world for good… or evil in this case!
 
To help you prepare for your fiendish role, we’ve created a gameplay video that will provide you with a sneak peek of what to expect. You will need all the help you can get when you battle investigators, corrupt cops and Ancient horrors, as you traverse the unsuspecting town of Arkham.

The story-adventures don’t end when you’ve completed the game, you can download playable mods from the Steam Workshop or you can create your own Lovecraftian events (or any story you want) with our content creator.

We’re looking forward to ending the world and descending into madness with you! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Slight misalignment in the Stars
notes.notes:
It is with regret that we announce a delay in the release of Fhtagn! At Design Imps we strive to release a product that is as bug-free as possible and a game that we feel excited about playing – and most importantly, that you will feel excited about playing! Unfortunately, we cannot in good conscience release the current version of the game as there is still much testing and polish to be done, to bring it to a standard that we feel happy with. We apologise for this delay and hope to get the final product to you within the next few weeks. 

We hope you can bear with us a while longer and that you will be pleased with the end result. Till the stars align … M’rgl B’rgl!
